name: Blackened Tilapia with Minty Zucchini Mango Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim ends, peel, and small dice zucchini. Small dice tomatoes. Transfer both to a large bowl.
Peel the mangoes and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the large bowl.
Seed the bell peppers, small dice, and transfer to the large bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice the limes over the veggies; add oil and spices and toss until well coated. Set aside in fridge until ready to serve.
In a small bowl, combine the spices for the fish.
Using paper towel, pat the fillets dry, then rub with spice mixture on both sides.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, add the fillets to the skillet and cook, 3 minutes per side, until opaque and cooked through.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with blackened tilapia. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
